content.text:
You are implementing a small UI change in a Next.js 16 + shadcn (style "base-nova", built on @base-ui/react, NOT radix) + Tailwind v4 app.

WORK ONLY in this git worktree: /Users/itsmeyaw/projects/binden/.worktrees/ui-polish (branch `ui/auth-screens`, already checked out). Do not touch /Users/itsmeyaw/projects/binden itself. Run all commands with that worktree as cwd. Do not switch branches, do not push.

Rules (from repo AGENTS.md):
- Use shadcn components + Tailwind utility classes only. Never write custom CSS. If a shadcn component is needed and missing from src/components/ui, add it with `pnpm dlx shadcn@latest add <name>` (run in the worktree). Do not hand-write ui primitives.
- This Next.js version may differ from your training data; consult node_modules/next/dist/docs/ if you touch Next APIs.
- Minimal, boring code. No new npm dependencies. No new abstractions beyond what's described.
- Preserve existing behavior and all accessible names used by e2e tests.

TASK: Make the login page (src/app/page.tsx) and the signup page (src/app/sign-up/page.tsx + src/components/signup-form.tsx) look like a consistent, polished pair, modelled on the shadcn "login-03" block (muted full-height background, small brand mark above a centered Card). Specifically:

1. Create one small shared server component `src/components/auth-shell.tsx` exporting `AuthShell({ children })` that renders: `<main className="flex min-h-svh flex-col items-center justify-center gap-6 bg-muted p-6 md:p-10">` containing a `max-w-sm`(login) — accept an optional `className` for width so signup can use `max-w-md` — column with a brand link to "/" at top (a small `bg-primary text-primary-foreground` rounded square with lucide `UsersRoundIcon` or similar + text "PM3 Muenchen e.V.", font-heading font-medium), then children.
2. Login (src/app/page.tsx): use AuthShell; put content in a shadcn Card: CardHeader centered with CardTitle "Welcome back" and CardDescription "Sign in with your PM3 Muenchen Google Workspace account to review signup requests." CardContent with the existing `<AuthButton className="w-full" label="Login with Google Workspace" />` (keep the label text exactly). Below the button, a FieldDescription centered: "Don't have an account? <Link href="/sign-up">Request one</Link>". If the URL has `?error=sign-in` (AuthButton's errorCallbackURL is "/?error=sign-in"), show a destructive Alert above the button: title "Sign-in failed", description "We couldn't sign you in with Google. Please try again." Read searchParams via the page props (in Next 16 `searchParams` is a Promise: `export default async function Home({ searchParams }: PageProps<"/">)` and `const { error } = await searchParams`). Also add a short muted footnote below the card (FieldDescription, centered, px-6): "Only managed Workspace accounts can sign in."
3. AuthButton (src/components/auth-button.tsx): add an inline Google "G" icon before the label when action is "sign-in" and not pending (inline svg with `data-icon="inline-start"`, fill="currentColor", the standard Google G path is fine as a single monochrome path). Keep everything else identical.
4. Signup page: use AuthShell with wider width (max-w-md). In SignupForm:
   - Put Given name and Family name side by side on sm+ screens (`grid gap-... sm:grid-cols-2` wrapping the two Field elements — check src/components/ui/field.tsx for an existing pattern/class like FieldGroup or a grid; keep it simple).
   - Add `placeholder`s ("Ada", "Lovelace", "ada@example.com", "+49 89 1234567", "e.g. volunteer at the summer festival").
   - Add FieldDescription under Contact email: "We'll only use this to reach you about your request."
   - SUCCESS STATE: after a successful submit (response.ok), replace the whole form with a success view inside the card (CheckCircle2 icon in a primary-tinted circle, title "Request received", the server `message` text, and an outline Button rendered as link back to "/" labelled "Back to sign in" — Button in base-nova uses `render={<Link href="/" />}` + `nativeButton={false}`, check src/components/ui/button.tsx and existing usages like review-request.tsx "Back to requests"). Track success with a boolean state rather than `notice.startsWith("Your")`; error notices stay as the destructive Alert above the form.
   - Below the card add a centered FieldDescription: "Already have an account? <Link href="/">Sign in</Link>".
   Keep all labels, ids, validation, Turnstile, and submit behavior unchanged.
5. Keep the app/page.tsx default export name and paths unchanged.

VERIFY: run `pnpm lint`, `pnpm format`, and `pnpm exec tsc --noEmit` in the worktree; all must pass (format writes; re-run lint after). Then commit with git in the worktree in 1-2 small commits with concise imperative messages (e.g. "Share a branded auth shell for login and signup", "Show a success view after a signup request"). No Co-Authored-By trailers.

Report back: files changed, commit hashes, and anything you could not do.

content.text:
Both pages now share an `AuthShell`, and the signup form has a success view. Two commits are on `ui/auth-screens`, and type check, lint, and format all pass. I did not run the browser or Playwright e2e tests.

**Commits**
- `c0f9bb1` Share a branded auth shell for login and signup
- `8791d08` Show a success view after a signup request

The first commit also contains the Google "G" icon in `AuthButton`. It went in with the shell because it was already in the working tree when I staged, so the split is slightly less clean than planned.

**Files changed**
- `src/components/auth-shell.tsx` (new): `AuthShell` with a `className` prop, defaulting to `max-w-sm`. It renders the brand link to "/" with the `UsersRoundIcon` mark.
- `src/app/page.tsx`: login now uses `AuthShell` and a `Card` titled "Welcome back". It shows the "Sign-in failed" destructive Alert when `?error=sign-in` is present, and it keeps the existing button label. Below the card is the footnote. The `h1` "Welcome to PM3 Muenchen e.V." is gone, since the brand mark and card title replace it.
- `src/components/auth-button.tsx`: inline Google "G" svg before the label for `sign-in` when not pending. Nothing else changed.
- `src/app/sign-up/page.tsx`: uses `AuthShell className="max-w-md"` and adds the "Already have an account? Sign in" link below the card.
- `src/components/signup-form.tsx`: given and family name sit side by side from `sm` up. Placeholders are added, and there is a hint under contact email. A `submitted` boolean drives the success card with the CheckCircle2 icon, the server message, and a `Back to sign in` outline button (`render={<Link href="/" />}`, `nativeButton={false}`). Errors stay in the destructive Alert, which no longer uses the `startsWith("Your")` check.

**Verification**
- `tsc --noEmit`, `oxlint --deny-warnings`, and `oxfmt --check` all pass. `tests/signup.ts` passes too.
- Initially `tsc` reported missing `PageProps`/`RouteContext` types. I ran `next typegen` to generate them, which writes only to the gitignored `.next` directory.

**Things I could not do as specified**
- `pnpm exec` and `pnpm lint`/`pnpm format` would not run. The worktree's `node_modules` is a symlink to `/Users/itsmeyaw/projects/binden/node_modules`, and pnpm refused to act on it because it resolves outside the worktree. I did not force it. I ran the local `tsc`, `oxlint`, and `oxfmt` binaries through the symlink instead, which is equivalent.
- The Playwright e2e suite was not run, and I did not visually check the layout in a browser.
- The `ponytail` and `grill` skills did not change anything here. I kept the diff to the spec.
